title: Lead I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role description**  

Who we are



At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30\+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.



Summary



UST is looking for an experienced **MERN Stack / Full Stack Developer** with strong expertise in **Node.js** and hands\-on experience building scalable, secure, and high\-performing web applications. The ideal candidate will have end\-to\-end development experience across **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js**, along with experience in **Snowflake, REST API development, cloud technologies, and CI/CD**.



Candidates with experience in **healthcare data analytics and US Healthcare systems** will be preferred.



The Opportunity



We are seeking a skilled MERN Stack / Full Stack Developer to design, develop, integrate, and maintain scalable web applications and backend services. The role will involve working across the complete software development lifecycle and collaborating with stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.


### **Key Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Design and develop scalable **full\-stack web applications** using the **MERN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js**.
* Develop robust and reusable backend services and APIs using **Node.js and Express.js**.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly frontend applications using **React.js and JavaScript (ES6\+)**.
* Design and implement efficient data models and database solutions using **MongoDB**.
* Work with **Snowflake** for data integration, analytics, and data\-driven application requirements.
* Develop, integrate, and consume **REST APIs** for application and system integrations.
* Implement asynchronous programming, error handling, authentication, authorization, and application security best practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, data teams, and other engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Participate in application design, development, testing, debugging, deployment, and production support activities.
* Use **Git/Bitbucket** for source code management, branching, pull requests, and collaborative development.
* Develop and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** and support automated application deployment.
* Leverage **GitHub Copilot and AI\-assisted IDE/CLI tools** to improve software development lifecycle (SDLC) productivity and code quality.
* Support application containerization and deployment using **Docker**.
* Work with cloud\-based environments, preferably **AWS**, for application development and deployment.
* Follow coding standards, secure development practices, unit testing, code reviews, and Agile methodologies.
* Analyze and resolve technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and application defects.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and provide clear technical communication throughout the development lifecycle.


What you need


### **Required Skills**


* **5\+ years of overall professional experience** in MERN Stack / Full Stack Development.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in:
	+ **Node.js**
	+ **Express.js**
	+ **React.js**
	+ **MongoDB**
* Strong knowledge of **JavaScript (ES6\+)** and asynchronous programming.
* Experience in **REST API development, integration, and consumption**.
* Experience with **Snowflake** and data\-driven application development.
* Strong understanding of full\-stack application architecture and development.
* Experience with **Git/Bitbucket** and version control practices.
* Good understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and application deployment**.
* Experience using **AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, AI\-enabled IDEs, or CLI tools** within the SDLC.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong **stakeholder management and collaboration** capabilities.

### **Desired Skills**


* Knowledge of **Python and Python REST APIs** for scripting, backend services, or integration tasks.
* Experience with **AWS** cloud services and application deployment.
* Experience with **Docker and containerization**.
* Knowledge of healthcare data analytics and healthcare information systems.
* Prior experience working in the **US Healthcare industry**.
* Understanding of healthcare\-specific data, workflows, and regulatory considerations.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

### **Qualification**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Linguistics, Engineering, or a related field**.
* **Ph.D. preferred**.
* Equivalent technical education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

### **Key Competencies**


**MERN Stack \| Full Stack Development \| Node.js \| Express.js \| React.js \| MongoDB \| Snowflake \| JavaScript \| ES6\+ \| REST APIs \| Python \| AWS \| Docker \| CI/CD \| Bitbucket \| Git \| GitHub Copilot \| AI\-Assisted Development \| Healthcare Data Analytics \| US Healthcare \| Stakeholder Management \| Agile \| SDLC**



What we believe



UST values **Humility, Humanity, and Integrity**. We believe in creating an environment where people can collaborate, innovate, learn, and deliver meaningful impact for our clients and communities.



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement



UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We believe diversity and inclusion strengthen our organization and enable us to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

 **Skills**  

MERN, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, React, Python, REST, Healthcare Data Analytics, CI/CD, Docker, Containerization

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**About Starburst**
-------------------



Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock\-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

#### **About the Team**



We build the AI layer for Starburst's products, including AIDA. We design agents that let users ask questions in natural language and get accurate, grounded answers backed by their actual data. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated platform engineering hire on the team.


#### **Role Summary**



You will build the shared development primitives that make multiple product teams faster, with clean abstractions across the Python/JVM boundary. This role is a force multiplier: instead of building product features directly, you build the platform, SDK, and tooling that enables every other engineer on the team to ship faster.



You will own the developer experience for agent development at Starburst, building from 0 to 1 and scaling across teams. Your work is measured by other engineers' velocity, not your own feature output.


#### **As an AI Platform Engineer at Starburst, you will:**


* Design and build an agent development SDK that abstracts common patterns (tool registration, context management, evaluation hooks, prompt management)
* Build the language bridge between Python (AI ecosystem) and JVM (Starburst platform) with type safety, error propagation, and observability across the boundary
* Create developer tooling: local development environments, debugging tools, test harnesses, CI integration
* Define and maintain API contracts between the AI layer and the Starburst platform
* Build shared infrastructure: model gateway, observability pipeline, experiment framework
* Develop unified, product\-agnostic components used across multiple products
* Own platform health beyond feature delivery: performance, reliability, developer ergonomics

#### **Some of the things that we look for:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling
* Proficiency in both Python and JVM languages (Java or Kotlin)
* Experience designing APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals: RPC, serialization, error handling, observability
* Experience with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
* Track record of building tools that measurably improve other engineers' velocity

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with LLM integration patterns: model APIs, token management, streaming, tool use
* Experience with cross\-language interop (gRPC, FFI, language bridges)
* Open\-source contributions to developer tooling or infrastructure projects
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and experiment infrastructure
* Experience supporting both research and production workloads on the same platform
* Java agent framework experience (LangChain4j)
* **Ability to Travel**: This role will require 25% in\-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

**Build your career at Starburst**
----------------------------------



All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry\-proven technology and unprecedented success, All\-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future.



Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.



We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All\-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All\-Stars to show up authentically.



Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state  

 or local laws.

title: Sr Kafka Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role
  

Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  

  

In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high\-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  

  

What you will do
  

Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  

Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission\-critical applications running.

  

Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud\-based services.
  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience
  

  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST\-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design \- Microservices architecture, containers (Docker \& k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  

Preferred skills and experience
  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) \- otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.Js)
description:
**About Josys**
---------------


Josys is a modern AI\-native identity security and governance platform. Enterprise AI adoption has made identity the fastest\-growing attack surface, and the hardest to govern. Josys discovers, governs, and secures every identity, human, machine, and AI agent, across every application in the enterprise, allowing security and IT teams to surface risk, control access, and remediate identity threats in real\-time.


Trusted by over 1,000 organizations and MSPs worldwide, Josys turns identity from the fastest\-growing attack surface into an autonomously governed advantage.


For more information, visit josys.com.

**About The Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer with strong hands\-on Node.js experience** to join our backend engineering team.


Node.js will be the **primary technology focus** for this role. You will build and maintain backend services, APIs, and scalable systems while working closely with product and engineering teams.


Our backend environment includes both **Node.js and Ruby on Rails**. You do not need prior Rails experience to be successful in this role, but you should be comfortable learning Rails and contributing to existing Rails services as you grow into the role.


We are looking for a strong individual contributor with good engineering fundamentals, practical system design experience, and the ability to take ownership of backend projects from development through production.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **3–7 years of backend software development experience**, with strong hands\-on experience using **Node.js**. Exceptionally strong candidates with \~2 years of experience may also be considered.
* Strong proficiency in **JavaScript and/or TypeScript**.
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining **production\-grade backend services and REST APIs**.
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, asynchronous programming, object\-oriented programming, and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience working with databases, data modelling, and writing efficient queries.
* Experience with background jobs, queues, asynchronous processing, or event\-driven systems.
* Comfortable working on existing codebases and contributing independently with minimal hand\-holding.
* Ability to participate in **system design discussions** and reason through architecture, scalability, performance, reliability, and technical trade\-offs.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate and resolve production issues.
* Genuine, hands\-on experience using **AI\-assisted development tools** such as Cursor or similar tools. Candidates should be able to explain how they use AI for development, debugging, testing, code review, and improving productivity.
* Strong ownership of previous projects, with the ability to explain their actual technical contribution in depth.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, preferably **AWS**.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Good To Have**
----------------

* **Ruby on Rails experience**.
* Experience with Rails background processing tools such as Sidekiq, Resque, ActiveJob, or Shoryuken.
* Experience working across multiple backend languages or frameworks.
* Experience with microservices and distributed systems.
* Experience with AWS services and cloud\-native architecture.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience with automated testing and CI/CD practices.

**Mindset We Value**
--------------------

* **Willingness to learn:** You don't need to know Rails today, but you should be comfortable picking it up and working across different technologies.
* **Strong IC mindset:** You can take ownership, navigate an existing codebase, and start contributing quickly.
* **Engineering fundamentals:** We value people who understand why something should be built a certain way, not just how to implement it.
* **Problem\-solving:** You are comfortable working through ambiguous technical problems and finding practical solutions.
* **Customer focus:** You understand that backend engineering ultimately impacts product reliability and customer experience.
* **AI\-native development:** You actively use AI tools to make yourself more effective while still maintaining strong engineering judgment and code quality.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and deploy backend services primarily using **Node.js**.
* Build and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable REST APIs.
* Work with databases and backend infrastructure to deliver high\-performing services.
* Contribute to system architecture and technical design decisions.
* Work across our backend stack and gradually contribute to **Ruby on Rails services** as required.
* Debug and resolve technical issues across development and production environments.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Participate in code reviews and help maintain strong engineering standards.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, frontend engineers, and other backend engineers.
* Contribute to technical estimations, sprint planning, and prioritization.
* Work with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, and contribute to improving scalability, availability, and security.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve development speed, code quality, testing, and problem\-solving.
* Stay current with relevant backend technologies and contribute ideas that improve engineering practices and team productivity.

title: Test Architect - C# with Selenium
description:
### **Job Title**

Test Architect \- C\# with Selenium
### **Job Description**

Job Description
**Job Description**

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to** join the leading innovator in image\-guided therapy solutions as a Software Developer for the Azurion Eye Sensing Lab. You will be responsible for developing the user interfaces for all OneSpace\-deployed clinical dashboards — delivering intuitive, high\-performance front\-end experiences that surface AI\-driven insights and analytics to clinical users in the interventional lab.


**You will be part of** the Image Guided Therapy Systems (IGTS) business unit with development sites in the Netherlands, China and India. You will join the Data Analytics team within the Sensing Lab global R\&D department, working closely with design (IENS), backend, and data engineering teams.


**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Define and own the automated test strategy and framework for all Data Analytics dashboards, microservices, and data pipelines.
* Lead the design and development of automated test scripts covering UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end test scenarios.
* Mentor and technically guide the Automation Engineer(s) on test architecture, tooling, and best practices.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipeline integration for automated test execution and reporting.
* Collaborate with developers and the Technical Leader during design and code reviews to ensure testability is built in.
* Define test coverage metrics, quality KPIs, and defect management processes.
* Triage, investigate, and drive resolution of test failures; work with development teams to ensure timely defect fixes.
* Contribute to regulatory documentation: test plans, test protocols, and test reports required for QMS compliance.
* Evaluate and recommend test tooling, frameworks, and automation libraries aligned with the tech stack.
* Continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, and pipeline execution speed.

**To Succeed in This Role, You Should Have the Following Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with at least 3 years in a lead/senior automation role.
* Must Have:
* C\# — primary automation scripting language
* ISTQB certification (Foundation or Advanced level)
* Automation tools — test frameworks such as Selenium, SpecFlow, NUnit, Playwright, or equivalent
* Nice to Have:
* Python — scripting and tooling
* Kubernetes / Docker — for containerized test environment setup
* API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestSharp)
* Performance testing tools
* Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks from scratch in agile/SAFe environments.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD integration for test automation (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions).
* Experience in regulated software development environments (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, or FDA frameworks) is strongly preferred.
* Excellent analytical skills; ability to assess test coverage gaps and translate requirements into test cases.
* Strong communication and leadership skills; ability to influence quality practices across the team.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate test design and automation.

  

* System Integration Testing (SIT)

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .

**T — Transparency.** We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
